name: World In Your Hands (WIYH)
tagline: 1,045 h of in-the-wild human manipulation from the chest- and glove-mounted Oracle Suite across 8+ scenes, with hand and camera poses.

annotations.coverageNote: Every sample has a task description, subtask intervals, per-frame camera and end-effector poses and hand states; atomic instructions cover ~400 of 1,045 h.

narrations.note: task_description plus one description per subtask

action_labels.note: Subtask intervals with timestamp_range, frame_index_range and status

segmentation.note: Paper: SAM instance masks; not in the card's JSON spec

hand_pose.note: hand_states vectors per frame; paper describes 3D hand skeletons

camera_pose.note: ego_poses per camera relative to frame 0 and chest-frame camera poses

depth.note: Paper: FoundationStereo-estimated depth; not in the card's JSON spec

qa_language.note: Paper: 100k vision-language instances; not in the card's JSON spec
